# NJ Fence and Railing

> Providing top-tier fencing and railing solutions for the most demanding residential and commercial projects across New Jersey.

## About
NJ Fence and Railing is a premier contractor based in Passaic, New Jersey. We specialize in custom railing, aluminum fences, and professional repair services.
